blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Veteran Cebuano bowler Rene Ceniza showcased his winning form once again, outscoring his fellow senior keglers to capture the title in the Sugbuanon Bowlers United (SUGBU) shootout tournament last Sunday at the SM Seaside Bowling and Leisure Center. A familiar face on the winners’ podium, Ceniza, who also won the July and August editions of the tournament, rolled 865 pinfalls in the four-game series to claim another championship. He saved his best performance for the final game, knocking down 244 pins to finish on top of the 27-player field. READ: Sevilla, Regino clinch November bowling titles; Reyes, […]...
